newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket - Western Australia win by five wickets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket - Western Australia win by five wickets.

text.p: Western Australia captain Tom Moody hit an unbeaten 89 to lead his side to victory by five wickets over South Australia on the final day of their Sheffield Shield match on Monday.
Moody's innings took his side to 288 for five after Western Australia had been set a target of 285 to win. South Australia were dismissed for 325 in their second innings earlier in the day.
The win was Western Australia's first of the season while South Australia remain at the bottom of the Shield table.
